sections.title: Three direction words
sections.content: To say which way, use three small words that never change: *jobbra* (to the right), *balra* (to the left) and *egyenesen* (straight on). With *megy* they say which way you go: *Balra megyek.* With *van* they say where something is: *Jobbra van a bank.* They usually come first in the sentence, because the direction is the news.

sections.title: Which way?
rows: to the right, on the right
to the left, on the left

items.english: The bank is on the right.
The museum is on the left.

sections.content: Learn *jobbra* and *balra* as whole words. They cover both "to the right" and "on the right", so you need only one word with *megy* and with *van*.
